subject: Maths
topic: Four Operations and Order of Operations
title: Checking answers using inverse operations
subtitle: Four Operations and Order of Operations · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can use inverse operations to check calculations and verify my answers.

key_vocab.definition: Inverse operations are operations that undo each other. Addition undoes subtraction. Multiplication undoes division.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can use inverse operations to check calculations and verify my answers.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Inverse operations -- Inverse operations are operations that undo each other. Addition undoes subtraction. Multiplication undoes division.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Use the inverse operation on your answer to get back to the starting number. If you do, your answer is correct.
45 + 32 = 77 ↔ check: 77 − 32 = 45 ✓
Inverse undoes the operation

Key examples:
  ✓ + and − are inverses  (undo each other)
  ✓ × and ÷ are inverses  (undo each other)
  ✓ If 7 × 8 = 56, then 56 ÷ 8 = 7  (check)
  ✗ + and × are inverses  (wrong pairing)
  ✗ Inverse of squaring is halving  (it is square-rooting)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – checking addition
  Check: 156 + 89 = 245
  Use inverse: 245 − 89
  245 − 89 = 156
  156 matches → correct ✓
  Correct ✓
  (Subtract one addend from the sum; you should get the other.)

Example 2 – checking multiplication
  Check: 23 × 15 = 345
  Use inverse: 345 ÷ 15
  345 ÷ 15 = 23
  23 matches → correct ✓
  Correct ✓
  (Divide the product by one factor; you should get the other.)

sections.title: Check additions
sections.content:
Use inverse (subtraction) to check. Write correct or incorrect.

(a) 78 + 45 = 123
(b) 156 + 89 = 245
(c) 234 + 178 = 402
(d) 67 + 88 = 155

sections.title: Mixed checking
sections.content:
Check each calculation using the inverse. State correct or give the right answer.

(a) 56 + 78 = 134
(b) 15 × 16 = 250
(c) 900 ÷ 25 = 36
(d) 1000 − 382 = 628
(e) 17 × 19 = 323

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ The inverse of addition is subtraction
✗ The inverse of multiplication is addition
✓ If 7 × 8 = 56, then 56 ÷ 7 = 8
✗ The inverse of squaring is dividing by 2
✓ Checking answers helps find mistakes
